parking: We have plenty of parking in front of our store.
neighborhood: Far West Side / Culebra corridor, San Antonio
cuisine: Gulf Coast seafood, American, oyster bar
priceRange: About $30 and under for most guests
payments: We accept major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover).
wifi: Ask your server for the Wi‑Fi details when you arrive.

allergies.summary: We can accommodate most allergy requests. Please tell your server about any allergies when you arrive.
allergies.shellfish: Shellfish is limited for us — it touches most of our kitchen, so we cannot guarantee a shellfish-free environment. If you have a shellfish allergy, please call us so we can talk through options safely.
allergies.gluten: We offer a gluten-free menu — mention celiac or allergy needs when you order so we can take extra care.
allergies.vegetarian: We have some non-seafood options (salads, chicken dishes, burger, sides). Ask your server what's best for vegetarian guests that day.
allergies.vegan: Vegan options are more limited. Call ahead or ask a manager so we can guide you honestly.

privateEvents.summary: Yes — we host private events. Call us at (210) 455-3474 and ask for a manager.

catering.summary: Yes — we offer catering. Call (210) 455-3474 and ask about catering options for your group or event.

policies.allergyDisclaimer: Please notify your server of severe allergies upon arrival so our kitchen can take extra precautions against cross-contamination.
policies.allergyDisclaimerEs: Por favor avise a su mesero de alergias graves al llegar para que la cocina pueda tomar precauciones extra contra la contaminación cruzada.
policies.managerOption: please call (210) 455-3474 and ask for a manager, or ask for a manager when you arrive.
policies.kidsMenuEntrees: Yes! We offer a dedicated Kids Menu featuring Kids Fish Sticks, Fried Shrimp, Chicken Strips, Cheeseburgers, Hamburgers, and Mac & Cheese.
policies.kidsMenuEntreesEs: ¡Sí! Ofrecemos un menú infantil con palitos de pescado, camarón frito, tiras de pollo, hamburguesas con queso, hamburguesas y macarrones con queso.
policies.kidsMealSidesBrief: All kids meals include your choice of ONE side, and we can substitute pretty much any standard side upon request!
policies.kidsMealSidesBriefEs: Todas las comidas infantiles incluyen tu elección de UNA guarnición, y podemos sustituir casi cualquier guarnición estándar si lo pides.
policies.kidsMealSides: Kids sides are Broccoli, Virginia's Apple Cider Coleslaw, Corn on the Cob, White Rice, Hush Puppies, or Fries.
policies.kidsMealSidesEs: Las guarniciones infantiles son brócoli, ensalada de col Virginia's Apple Cider, elote, arroz blanco, bolitas de maíz fritas o papas fritas.
policies.dishAllergenSideSwap: We can swap any listed side for another listed side — just tell your server.
policies.dishAllergenSideSwapEs: Podemos cambiar cualquier guarnición listada por otra — solo dile a tu mesero.
policies.sideSubstitutions: Absolutely! You can swap those fries for coleslaw, buttermilk mashed potatoes, black beans and rice, or hush puppies. What would you prefer?
policies.sideSubstitutionsEs: ¡Por supuesto! Puedes cambiar esas papas por ensalada de col, puré de papa buttermilk, frijoles negros con arroz, o hush puppies. ¿Cuál prefieres?
policies.pastSpecialsRule: Host tone for past chalkboard specials: acknowledge that boards rotate; immediately suggest a concrete available-menu build (never ask the guest to list flavors); confirm side swaps in one smooth sentence; keep replies to 3–4 sentences; never repeat disclaimers, links, or phone numbers.
policies.glutenFryer: We offer a gluten-free menu. We cannot promise a separate fryer from breaded chicken or other fried items — shared oil / cross-contact can happen; please notify your server of severe allergies upon arrival so our kitchen can take extra precautions against cross-contamination.
policies.glutenFryerEs: Tenemos menú sin gluten. No podemos garantizar una freidora separada del pollo empanizado u otros fritos — puede haber aceite compartido / contaminación cruzada; por favor avise a su mesero de alergias graves al llegar para que la cocina pueda tomar precauciones extra contra la contaminación cruzada.
policies.largePartyAnswer: For a group this size, please call (210) 455-3474 directly so our management team can secure the best table available for you.
policies.largePartyAnswerEs: Para grupos de este tamaño, por favor llama directamente al (210) 455-3474 para que nuestro equipo de gerencia te asegure la mejor mesa disponible.

reservations.summary: Yes — we take reservations. I can take one right here, or you can call (210) 455-3474.
reservations.walkIns: Walk-ins are welcome. Waits can happen when we're busy — reservations are the safest bet for a preferred time.
reservations.largePartyAnswer: I am alerting our management team right now. Please stay on the line while I connect you to a manager.
reservations.largePartyAnswerEs: Estoy alertando a nuestro equipo de gerencia ahora mismo. Por favor quédate en la línea mientras te conecto con un gerente.
reservations.kids: Families are welcome. Kids menu options come with exactly one side choice.
reservations.highChairs: High chairs / booster seats are typically available — ask when you arrive or note it on your reservation request.
reservations.splitChecks: We can usually split checks — let your server know early in the meal.
reservations.corkageAnswer: Ask a manager about corkage / bringing your own bottle — call (210) 455-3474.
reservations.cake: You're welcome to ask about bringing a celebration cake — call ahead so we can plan with you: (210) 455-3474.
reservations.giftCards: Gift cards are available — ask your server or call the restaurant.
reservations.managerEscalation: To speak with management, I am alerting our team right now. Please stay on the line while I connect you to a manager.
reservations.managerEscalationEs: Para hablar con gerencia, estoy alertando a nuestro equipo ahora mismo. Por favor quédate en la línea mientras te conecto con un gerente.

takeout.summary: To-go / takeout is available. I can take a to-go request right here, or you can call (210) 455-3474.

delivery.summary: For delivery options, call the restaurant at (210) 455-3474 and we'll walk you through what's available.

accessibility.summary: If you need accessibility details (wheelchair access, seating, etc.), call us at (210) 455-3474 and we'll help you plan.

pets.summary: Yes — our patio is dog-friendly. Service animals are welcome.
pets.answer: Yes, our patio is dog-friendly! Service animals are welcome indoors as well.

outdoor.answer: Ask us about patio / outdoor seating availability when you call or reserve — it can change with weather and demand: (210) 455-3474.

alcohol.summary: Yes — we serve beer, wine, cocktails, and mocktails. Happy Hour Sun–Fri 3–6pm.

rawBar.summary: Yes — we have a raw bar with oysters (including Mystic Mermaid), plus items like ahi tuna tartare.
